verification_kind: analytic proofs with exact finite self-checks; no independent end-to-end audit or formalization

claims.statement: No fixed theta>0 and finite kappa make K_occ >= theta L - kappa I hold for all Boolean sources when L is the unnormalized full squared-autocorrelation logarithmic tariff of the sign-aligned I-projection reference.
claims.scope: All-source extension only; does not refute the predecessor's sparse-family calibration or composition-prime-only targets.
claims.witness: F_k=y times k disjoint copies of the three-variable one-point defect; Z=319/256 and L_k=k Z^(k-1) L.
claims.verification: Exact Walsh fractions and rational-log k=32 certificate; analytic exponential argument covers every finite coefficient.

claims.statement: T=L/Z is additive for tensor normalized real amplitude vectors.
claims.scope: Support-conditioned Boolean reference amplitudes factor under disjoint Boolean tensors. Unconditioned completions must be chosen multiplicatively for the same conclusion.
claims.remaining_obligation: No universal KL comparison or general tensor-compatible zero-sign choice is proved.

claims.statement: On paired one-point-defect lifts, conditioned T/I tends to zero while residual shape KL/I=m-3+o(1). Thus no fixed-factor plus O(I) upper recovery of shape KL from the conditioned tariff holds.
claims.scope: Under-recovery, not a refutation of a lower KL bound. The family has H/I tending to two and is not an FEI counterexample.
claims.verification: Exact reference conditioning, closed shell identities, analytic asymptotics, tagged floating illustrations.

claims.statement: For the same paired family, unconditioned product-reference amplitudes with plus signs at zero Fourier coefficients satisfy T/4-K_shape=o(I).
claims.verification: Exact two-shell correlation formula and rational direct-correlation checks; analytic tail and normalization control.
claims.remaining_obligation: General sources, a universal KL payment, and general tensor-compatible completion remain open.

claims.statement: In n>=2, a Boolean function with any zero Walsh coefficient has all nonzero Walsh numerators divisible by four. Flipping one physical value produces full support, preserves all old nonzero signs, and assigns -f(x0)chi_S(x0) at old zeros.
claims.verification: Algebraic parity proof and exhaustive origin-flip checks for all functions in dimensions two through four.
claims.scope: Realizes the signs only. Reference magnitudes are not asserted to be Boolean.

claims.statement: Choose a fully source-defined completion and prove D(P||Q)>=T/4-kappa I with a dimension-independent kappa and a sufficient recovery ledger.
claims.remaining_obligation: All-source payment is unproved; low-total-influence full-support form implies an FEI estimate by the concurrent rare-activation admission calculation. Do not label it an easier theorem.
